title: House
description: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion, where supernatural events occur almost immediately.

title: Hollywood Without Makeup
description: A compilation of home movies that captures some of Hollywood's celebrities in candid, off-screen moments.

title: Jigoku
description: Horrific fates await two hit-and-run drivers who kill a yakuza.

title: A Well Spent Life
description: A tribute to the Texas musical performer Mance Lipscomb.

title: Whipsaw
description: An undercover man (Spencer Tracy) romances a pearl thief (Myrna Loy) away from her partners, who catch up.

title: Wife vs. Secretary
description: A publisher's (Clark Gable) wife (Myrna Loy) begins to think his secretary (Jean Harlow) is more than just his secretary.

title: Petticoat Fever
description: A lonesome wireless operator (Robert Montgomery) delays a couple (Myrna Loy, Reginald Owen) stranded in Labrador.

title: Parnell
description: Irish politician Charles Stewart Parnell (Clark Gable) has a ruinous Victorian affair with a married woman (Myrna Loy).

title: Man-Proof
description: A Manhattan socialite (Myrna Loy) flirts with a newsman (Franchot Tone) and her ex-lover, whose bride (Rosalind Russell) finds out.

title: Test Pilot
description: A famous test pilot (Clark Gable) meets his dream-girl (Myrna Loy) after making a forced landing in a Kansas cornfield.

title: Too Hot to Handle
description: A newsreel cameraman (Clark Gable) steals his rival's (Walter Pidgeon) girlfriend (Myrna Loy) and scoops him in the Amazon on a wild story.

title: Lucky Night
description: A beautiful heiress meets a charming homeless man. The two share a wild, drunken night that ends in a way neither of them could have imagined.

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
description: Time-and-motion-study pioneers Frank and Lillian Gilbreth (Clifton Webb, Myrna Loy) run their brood of 12 efficiently.

title: From the Terrace
description: A young veteran (Paul Newman) achieves financial and social success but is unhappy in his marriage to a socialite (Joanne Woodward).

title: Midnight Lace
description: Scotland Yard suspects a woman's (Doris Day) problem is not a crank caller but rather a busy husband (Rex Harrison).

title: Airport 1975
description: A jumbo jet's midair crisis puts a stewardess (Karen Black) in the cockpit until a pilot (Charlton Heston) can board by helicopter.

title: Lonelyhearts
description: A Midwestern reporter's (Montgomery Clift) cynical editor (Robert Ryan) makes him write an advice column for the lovelorn.

title: The Ambassador's Daughter
description: A GI (John Forsythe) falls for a U.S. ambassador's daughter (Olivia de Havilland) who fights a senator's plan to make Paris off limits.

title: The Man in Possession
description: A British bailiff's assistant (Robert Montgomery) poses as a butler to keep an eye on a woman (Irene Purcell) in trouble.

title: The Unguarded Hour
description: An ambitious prosecuting attorney seems guilty of strangling his mistress; only his blackmailed wife knows for sure.

title: Lord Jeff
description: A wayward British orphan (Freddie Bartholomew) graduates from the merchant marine academy to the Queen Mary.

title: Stablemates
description: An alcoholic veterinarian (Wallace Beery) helps a jockey (Mickey Rooney) whose future is riding on a race.

title: Our Town
description: A narrator (Frank Craven) relates a couple's (William Holden, Martha Scott) tale of life, love and death in New Hampshire.

title: Kings Row
description: Sin surrounds a Freudian doctor (Robert Cummings), his playboy buddy (Ronald Reagan) and the buddy's girlfriend (Ann Sheridan) in a circa-1900 town.

title: Command Decision
description: A U.S. general (Clark Gable) and his superior (Walter Pidgeon) take heat for sending bombers to Germany to destroy aircraft plants.

title: Arsenic and Old Lace
description: A theater critic (Cary Grant) learns his two elderly aunts serve poisoned elderberry wine to lonely gentlemen callers.

title: I Married a Witch
description: A politician's campaign for governor is complicated by a seductive witch with romance and revenge on her mind.

title: A Stolen Life
description: A New England artist (Bette Davis) takes the place and the husband (Glenn Ford) of her twin sister who has drowned.

title: The Stranger
description: A federal agent finds a Nazi war criminal married to a judge's daughter and teaching and living in New England.

title: Deathtrap
description: A cat-and-mouse game ensues when a blocked Broadway playwright (Michael Caine) and his wife (Dyan Cannon) meet a fan (Christopher Reeve) with an excellent script.

title: Ten Little Indians
description: Unwary houseguests meet their deaths when they are invited by an unknown host to a secluded mountain mansion.

title: A Night of Adventure
description: A lawyer (Tom Conway) tries discreetly to defend his wife's (Audrey Long) artist boyfriend for murder.

title: Upperworld
description: Blackmail and bullets end a married New York businessman's (Warren William) affair with a chorus girl (Ginger Rogers).

title: Private Detective 62
description: A down-and-out private eye (William Powell) falls for a woman (Margaret Lindsay) he has been hired to frame.

title: Second Chance
description: A hit man (Jack Palance) catches a gangster's ex-girlfriend (Linda Darnell) and her boxer lover (Robert Mitchum) on a mountain cable car.

title: The Secret Bride
description: An attorney general (Warren William) secretly marries the daughter (Barbara Stanwyck) of a governor accused of bribery.

title: Danger Signal
description: A suave schemer (Zachary Scott) flees to California, where he preys on two sisters (Faye Emerson, Mona Freeman) for a payoff.

title: Betrayed
description: A waitress (Kim Hunter) suspects her new husband (Dean Jagger), and another man (Robert Mitchum) she knows, of murder.

title: The Secret Fury
description: The man (Robert Ryan) a woman (Claudette Colbert) was going to marry tries to find the killer who's trying to drive her mad.

title: Shadow of Doubt
description: When a Hollywood producer is murdered, the most likely suspect is a man who is smitten with the victim's fiancée.

title: 100 Rifles
description: A sheriff helps a bank robber and a Yaqui beauty fight a tyrant general in 1912 Mexico.

title: The Greatest
description: Boxer Cassius Clay (Muhammad Ali) trains with Angelo Dundee (Ernest Borgnine), becomes heavyweight champion and converts to Islam.

title: Black Eye
description: An ex-police officer operating a private detective business comes face to face with a syndicate-backed dope ring.

title: Black Belt Jones
description: A martial artist (Jim Kelly) helps a father (Scatman Crothers) and daughter (Gloria Hendry) save their school of self-defense from Los Angeles mobsters.

title: Hit Man
description: An avenger (Bernie Casey) wades through the Los Angeles porno underworld in the name of his dead brother.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: Cain and Mabel
description: A chorus girl (Marion Davies) and a heavyweight boxer (Clark Gable) are paired romantically as a publicity stunt.

title: Brother Rat and a Baby
description: Virginia Military Institute graduates keep busy as an illustrator, football coach and rich man's son.

title: Susan and God
description: A socialite (Joan Crawford) annoys her husband (Fredric March) and friends with the new religion she brings home from England.

title: Damon and Pythias
description: Greek tyrant Dionysius puts the friendship of two men (Don Burnett, Guy Williams) to a life-or-death test.

title: Abbott and Costello in Hollywood
description: Two bumbling barbers (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) act as agents for an unknown singer and stage a phony murder to get him a coveted role.

title: Judge Hardy and Son
description: The judge (Lewis Stone) guides Andy (Mickey Rooney) through problems with girls, money and an essay contest.
